voiceSummary: Sammaan Capital Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The issue size comprised gross proceeds of Rs 36,933.98 million and net proceeds of Rs 36,134.68 million. No proceeds were utilized during the reported quarter. attchmntText: Please find enclosed a Press Release of the Company, for your information and record.
voiceSummary: Sammaan Capital Limited reported Q2 FY27 results ending September 30, 2026. Assets under management reached 59,188 crore rupees. Disbursements rose 62% quarter-on-quarter to 6,278 crore rupees. Profit after tax grew 28% to 312 crore rupees. Gross non-performing assets improved to 0.15%. Net non-performing assets declined to 0.11%. Capital adequacy stood at 20.0%. Net worth was 19,445 crore rupees. Avenir converted warrants into 8.69 crore equity shares at 139 rupees per share. This infusion totaled 906 crore rupees. Promoter shareholding increased from 28.34% to 33.32%. The company expanded its branch network to 245 branches. Full-year targets include assets under management of 70,700 crore rupees and profit after tax of 1,400 crore rupees.

voiceSummary: Sammaan Capital Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of 1,849.97 Crores for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Profit before tax stood at 424.57 Crores for the same period. Profit attributable to shareholders was 312.34 Crores. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 3,501.90 Crores. Profit before tax was 750.58 Crores. Profit attributable to shareholders was 555.64 Crores. The board also confirmed no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from equity shares and non-convertible debentures. A security cover certificate was issued for the quarter. Limited review reports were issued by joint statutory auditors M Verma & Associates and Nangia & Co LLP. The results were published on the company website and in newspapers.

voiceSummary: Sammaan Capital Limited filed an earnings update for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported Assets Under Management of 59,188 Cr and disbursements of 6,278 Cr in Q2. Profit After Tax was 312 Cr. Net Non-Performing Assets stood at 0.11 percent. Avenir converted Tranche I warrants into 8.69 Cr shares at 139 per share, infusing 906 Cr. This increased the promoter stake from 28.34 percent to 33.32 percent. The branch network expanded to 245 branches. The company launched personal loans through own origination and approved gold loans for commercial launch in Q4FY27. Salesforce Loan Origination System was rolled out to pilot branches. H.E. Dalia Khorshid was onboarded as an Independent Director nominee. BDO was appointed as co-sourcing partner for Internal Audit.
